evidence.excerpt: هُنَالِكَ تَبۡلُواْ كُلُّ نَفۡسٖ مَّآ أَسۡلَفَتۡۚ وَرُدُّوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَوۡلَىٰهُمُ ٱلۡحَقِّۖ وَضَلَّ عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَفۡتَرُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for this candidate topic.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Individual reckoning on return day.

candidates.label: Dispute concerning Quran resolved only by prior belief
candidates.definition: In 10:39: They dispute concerning it but none believe in it except those who submitted before its revelation.

evidence.excerpt: بَلۡ كَذَّبُواْ بِمَا لَمۡ يُحِيطُواْ بِعِلۡمِهِۦ وَلَمَّا يَأۡتِهِمۡ تَأۡوِيلُهُۥۚ كَذَٰلِكَ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡۖ فَٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for this candidate topic.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Prior submission enables recognition.

candidates.label: Ethical decalogue embedded within theological argument
candidates.definition: In 10:93: Do not approach orphan property except best way; give full measure weight with justice; speak justly even toward relative; fulfill covenant of Allah.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَقَدۡ بَوَّأۡنَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَـٰٓءِيلَ مُبَوَّأَ صِدۡقٖ وَرَزَقۡنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ فَمَا ٱخۡتَلَفُواْ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡعِلۡمُۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقۡضِي بَيۡنَهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُواْ فِيهِ يَخۡتَلِفُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for this candidate topic.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Ethical commands woven into tawheed discourse.
Justice in measurement and speech.

candidates.label: Brief worldly enjoyment as deceptive prelude to punishment
candidates.definition: In 10:52: Enjoyment of worldly life is brief then to Us is their return and We make them taste severe punishment.

evidence.excerpt: ثُمَّ قِيلَ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ ذُوقُواْ عَذَابَ ٱلۡخُلۡدِ هَلۡ تُجۡزَوۡنَ إِلَّا بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَكۡسِبُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for this candidate topic.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Temporal pleasure contrasted with eternal consequence.

candidates.label: Nuh tawakkul declaration as model of prophetic trust
candidates.definition: In 10:71: Upon Allah I trust and to Him I turn in repentance — Nuh's declaration before his people.

evidence.excerpt: ۞وَٱتۡلُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ نَبَأَ نُوحٍ إِذۡ قَالَ لِقَوۡمِهِۦ يَٰقَوۡمِ إِن كَانَ كَبُرَ عَلَيۡكُم مَّقَامِي وَتَذۡكِيرِي بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ فَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ تَوَكَّلۡتُ فَأَجۡمِعُوٓاْ أَمۡرَكُمۡ وَشُرَكَآءَكُمۡ ثُمَّ لَا يَكُنۡ أَمۡرُكُمۡ عَلَيۡكُمۡ غُمَّةٗ ثُمَّ ٱقۡضُوٓاْ إِلَيَّ وَلَا تُنظِرُونِ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for this candidate topic.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Tawakkul as prophetic posture.
Nuh's trust declaration.

candidates.label: Flood as divine sign and salvation mechanism
candidates.definition: In 10:73: They denied him so We saved him and those with him in the ark and made them successors and drowned deniers.

evidence.excerpt: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَنَجَّيۡنَٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِي ٱلۡفُلۡكِ وَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمۡ خَلَـٰٓئِفَ وَأَغۡرَقۡنَا ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَاۖ فَٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلۡمُنذَرِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for this candidate topic.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Ark salvation and drowning as dual sign.

candidates.label: Musa-Firawn confrontation with clear signs and magician conversion
candidates.definition: In 10:75-81: Musa and Harun sent to Firawn with clear authority; magicians believed after seeing truth; Firawn accused sorcery.

evidence.excerpt: ثُمَّ بَعَثۡنَا مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِم مُّوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَمَلَإِيْهِۦ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَٱسۡتَكۡبَرُواْ وَكَانُواْ قَوۡمٗا مُّجۡرِمِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for this candidate topic.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Magician conversion as pivotal moment.

candidates.label: Delayed belief after witnessing punishment provides no benefit
candidates.definition: In 10:96-97: Those against whom word proved due did not believe even when seeing punishment — faith must precede consequence.

evidence.excerpt: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ حَقَّتۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for this candidate topic.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Post-punishment belief invalidated.

candidates.label: Yunus exception proving timely belief efficacy
candidates.definition: In 10:98: No town believed and benefited from faith except people of Yunus — when they believed We removed disgrace and granted enjoyment.

evidence.excerpt: فَلَوۡلَا كَانَتۡ قَرۡيَةٌ ءَامَنَتۡ فَنَفَعَهَآ إِيمَٰنُهَآ إِلَّا قَوۡمَ يُونُسَ لَمَّآ ءَامَنُواْ كَشَفۡنَا عَنۡهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡخِزۡيِ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَمَتَّعۡنَٰهُمۡ إِلَىٰ حِينٖ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for this candidate topic.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Unique case of communal repentance succeeding.
Timely belief removes punishment.

candidates.label: Divine compulsion impossibility preserving human agency
candidates.definition: In 10:99: If your Lord had willed all on earth would have believed together — would you compel people to be believers?

evidence.excerpt: وَلَوۡ شَآءَ رَبُّكَ لَأٓمَنَ مَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ كُلُّهُمۡ جَمِيعًاۚ أَفَأَنتَ تُكۡرِهُ ٱلنَّاسَ حَتَّىٰ يَكُونُواْ مُؤۡمِنِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for this candidate topic.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Compulsion negated preserving choice.

candidates.label: No soul believes except by Allah's permission
candidates.definition: In 10:100: No soul can believe except by Allah's permission and He places wrath upon those who do not reason.

evidence.excerpt: وَمَا كَانَ لِنَفۡسٍ أَن تُؤۡمِنَ إِلَّا بِإِذۡنِ ٱللَّهِۚ وَيَجۡعَلُ ٱلرِّجۡسَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعۡقِلُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for this candidate topic.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Permission condition balanced with reasoning requirement.

candidates.label: Final tawakkul command with patience awaiting divine judgment
candidates.definition: In 10:109: Follow what has been revealed to you and be patient until Allah judges — He is the best of judges.

evidence.excerpt: وَٱتَّبِعۡ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيۡكَ وَٱصۡبِرۡ حَتَّىٰ يَحۡكُمَ ٱللَّهُۚ وَهُوَ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡحَٰكِمِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for this candidate topic.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Closing tawakkul-patience pairing.
Sabr until divine judgment.

candidates.label: Individual responsibility principle in guidance and misguidance
candidates.definition: In 10:108: Whoever is guided is guided for himself and whoever goes astray goes astray against himself — I am not guardian over you.

evidence.excerpt: قُلۡ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ قَدۡ جَآءَكُمُ ٱلۡحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكُمۡۖ فَمَنِ ٱهۡتَدَىٰ فَإِنَّمَا يَهۡتَدِي لِنَفۡسِهِۦۖ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيۡهَاۖ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ عَلَيۡكُم بِوَكِيلٖ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for this candidate topic.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Personal responsibility for spiritual direction.

candidates.label: Creation signs in heavens and earth as universal evidence
candidates.definition: In 10:101: Say look at what is in heavens and earth — signs and warners do not benefit people who refuse to believe.

evidence.excerpt: قُلِ ٱنظُرُواْ مَاذَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَمَا تُغۡنِي ٱلۡأٓيَٰتُ وَٱلنُّذُرُ عَن قَوۡمٖ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for this candidate topic.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Cosmic signs as accessible evidence.
